summary: PHASE HOTEL-2 frontend testing completed end-to-end. Verified as Super Admin at /hotel: all 4 tabs render (Hotel Search, Search History, API Settings, API Logs). Hotel Search form contains ALL required data-testids (hotel-search, hotel-searchtype-tabs, hotel-searchtype-city, hotel-searchtype-hotel, hotel-search-cityid, hotel-search-checkin, hotel-search-checkout, hotel-search-adults, hotel-search-children, hotel-search-currency, hotel-search-language, hotel-search-sortby, hotel-search-minstar, hotel-search-minreview, hotel-search-ratemin, hotel-search-ratemax, hotel-search-discountonly, hotel-search-submit). Occupancy dynamic: setting Anak=2 renders hotel-search-children-ages with hotel-search-childage-0 and hotel-search-childage-1; setting Anak=0 removes them. Hotel List tab replaces cityId with hotel-search-hotelids and hides city-only filters (sortby=0). Client-side validation: check-out before check-in fires Indonesian toast 'Check-out harus setelah check-in.'; empty cityId fires 'City ID wajib diisi untuk City Search.' Valid City Search shows hotel-search-loading with submit disabled during flight, then displays hotel-search-error with 'Autentikasi layanan hotel gagal. Silakan hubungi administrator.' (expected — no live Agoda key); submit re-enabled afterwards, no crash. Search History tab renders hotel-history table (not empty) and body contains NO api_key/bearer/authorization leaks. RBAC: Sales has Hotel sidebar link and /hotel shows ONLY Hotel Search + Search History tabs (API Settings/Logs hidden). Accounting sidebar has NO Hotel entry. Regression: Dashboard, CRM, Quotations load without errors for Super Admin.
critical_code_review_comments: HotelSearch.jsx is ~406 lines — still manageable but approaching the point where extracting the results card + detail dialog into separate components would improve readability.
validate() correctly enforces childrenAges length == numberOfChildren via setChildren truncation; buildPayload maps to backend contract cleanly.
inFlight ref + loading state prevents duplicate submits (verified: submit disabled during in-flight).
